updates.summary: All 15 raw brand-change candidates in the screened 68-district subset were audited: ten compared different equipment categories, four were aliases or the same product family, and one remained a different-brand purchase lead. Bensalem Aruba-to-Fortinet purchases do not prove replacement of installed equipment. Ten original PDFs support the five comparable-category cases; historical first-public timing is unverified. Zero verified installed replacements and zero public-timed investment observations. This subset is not representative of all districts.

updates.summary: On 15 evaluation months in 2020-2024, baseline MAE was 8.3764 log percentage points; adding weather worsened it to 8.4623. A zero-change baseline was better than both at 8.2709. Training used 30 months in 2010-2019. Six-state categorical outlooks were equally weighted, not acreage weighted. The price target partly elapsed before the forecast; cash prices are revised current vintages, not futures returns. Earlier exposure to some data means this is chronological evaluation, not untouched confirmation.

updates.summary: FY2024 Q3 versus FY2023 Q3: gross margin fell from 46.419% to 31.088% (-15.331 percentage points). Sold dozens rose while average selling price fell from $3.298 to $2.247 per dozen. Lower feed cost alone did not imply higher margins. Feed cost uses dozens produced; selling price uses dozens sold. Those denominators cannot be directly subtracted as an egg-margin measure. Kansas outbreak was within the quarter; the April 1 Texas outbreak followed the March 2 quarter end. Independently recomputed descriptive accounting; no event-return or predictive result.
